title: That's the Goodbye
hook: He flashes twice. You flash back.
scene: Ellensburg fuel depot at dusk. Deac tops off the Beetle himself and hands over the field notes and the photocard, and does not say anything that sounds like the end. Jonah reaches for the horn at the gate and doesn't; he flashes his headlights twice instead. You flash back. That is the whole goodbye — two clicks of a relay across a fuel lot, and then the road east without him in it.
debrief: Everything he had to say is in the notebook. Tonight you have a full tank, two cats, and the road east.

source.teaching_target: Beat, continue only: Deac hands over the field notes; the goodbye is the headlight relay. Nothing here is scored.
